description: Read the ROWS of a Notion database the user shared with Hermoso — e.g. the team's content calendar: each row's title, id, link and every property as a plain value (status, date, channels, caption, links), plus the database's columns with their types and options. Filter with match {"Status": "Scheduled"} (typed from the database's own columns) or a raw Notion filter object; sort with sortBy (a column, or created_time / last_edited_time) and direction. Up to 100 rows per call, cursor for more; the answer says when Notion stopped at its 10,000-result limit. Use it to import a calendar and schedule its posts, or to find the row update_notion_row changes. Read-only, free. Needs Notion connected (Settings > Connectors > Notion).

match.description: {"Column": value} — equality for status/select/checkbox/number/date, contains for text/multi-select

name: query_notion_database
title: Read a Notion database
